mapper.select: SELECT PC AS pc, DESCRIPTION AS description FROM PRODUCT_CLASS_MASTER ORDER BY PC
SELECT MARKET AS market, DESCRIPTION AS description FROM MARKET_MASTER ORDER BY MARKET
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_USER_DEFINED_RULES ( PC, NUM, MARKET, VS, VS2, VARIABLE, VAL, USERID, UP_DATE, COMMENTS, ADD_DATE, DELETE_DATE, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS ) VALUES ( #{pc}, #{num}, #{market}, #{vs}, #{vs2}, #{variable}, #{val}, #{userid}, #{upDate}, #{comments}, #{addDate}, #{deleteDate}, NOW(), #{registerUser}, #{registerProcess}, NOW(), #{updateUser}, #{updateProcess} )
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_USER_DEFINED_RULES SET VS = #{vs}, VS2 = #{vs2}, VARIABLE = #{variable}, VAL = #{val}, USERID = #{userid}, UP_DATE = #{upDate}, COMMENTS = #{comments}, ADD_DATE = #{addDate}, DELETE_DATE = #{deleteDate}, UPDATE_DATETIME = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_PROCESS = #{updateProcess} WHERE PC = #{pc} AND NUM = #{num} AND MARKET = #{market}
